versions.changelog:
No functional code changes; skill README clarified for users, orchestrators, and security reviewers.

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify strict boundaries between local inference (no API/web access) and optional data-generation or retraining tools.
- Added mandatory rule: orchestrators and clients must display all math as plain text (never LaTeX delimiters like $...$), matching enforced script output.
- Expanded security and usage notes, including reference to SECURITY.md.
- Minor corrections to references and output-format display instructions.

- Added triggers.txt file for improved skill activation and integration.
- No changes to core model, inference scripts, or functionality.

A-Level Physics CIE (9702) Answer Template Generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of a skill for generating structured answer templates for CIE A-Level Physics (9702) exam questions.
- Provides question-type classification, extraction of givens/required information, applicable formulae, stepwise solution templates, and checking advice.
- Fine-tuned Qwen3-4B model with LoRA trained on real past paper questions and mark-scheme-guided templates.
- Supports both Python API and command line usage for template generation and adversarial robustness evaluation.
- Includes retraining instructions, detailed reference documentation, and evaluation scripts.
